source.quote: Status cells are 16 by 16 logical pixels. ... Ready and Retry are static images.

rules.obligation: One static 16x16 image; exact check composition otherwise open.
rules.literal_delta: Exact dimensions/single frame/no strip/no extra canvas implement cell and static source, without narrower subject geometry.
rules.alternative: A 16x16 static asymmetrical check with a backing disc must pass geometry; a 64x16 four-frame strip fails the actual Ready obligation.
rules.returned_literal_check: Decoded image is exactly 16x16 pixels with a single static frame (no horizontal strip, no extra canvas).
rules.verified_disposition: Corrected returned literal wording inspected; consistent for this proposal only.

rules.obligation: Transparent background; partial subject alpha and intentional backing motifs remain open.
rules.literal_delta: Old 'no opaque ... box or fringe fills the cell' risks rejecting an intentional backing plate as subject rather than matte.
rules.alternative: A clearly readable asymmetrical blue-accented check on an intentional small disc, surrounded by transparent pixels, satisfies source but can fail a blanket plate/box exclusion.
rules.disposition: Require transparent exterior and no accidental matte; expressly allow intentional subject backing and partial alpha.
rules.returned_literal_check: The background outside the intentional subject is transparent (alpha 0), without an unintended opaque matte. Intentional backing motifs may be part of the subject; partial-alpha subject edges and effects are permitted.
rules.verified_disposition: Corrected returned literal wording inspected; consistent for this proposal only.

source.quote: Ready must visibly use a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion.

rules.obligation: Asymmetrical-arm check conveys success; no fixed stroke, ratio, highlight, centering or backing.
rules.literal_delta: Contrasting completion with activity/failure/pause/Start is a semantic expert interpretation; must be sample-alone, not require missing family assets.
rules.alternative: Outlined or thin readable asymmetrical check on a disc remains valid; equal-arm plus or activity loop fails explicit meaning. Actual future sibling comparison cannot be a first-sample prerequisite.
rules.disposition: Keep explicit motif and success, distinguish candidate semantic assessment from deferred family comparisons.
rules.returned_literal_check: Ready visibly uses a check mark with asymmetrical arms to convey successful completion. Assess this candidate alone; actual family distinction is a later collective check.
rules.verified_disposition: Corrected returned literal wording inspected; consistent for this proposal only.

source.quote: readable silhouettes ... Inspect at 1x and 3x nearest display scale on the actual dark panel.

rules.obligation: Readable silhouette at both scales; panel comes from src/queue-view.ts line9 #172336.
rules.literal_delta: No essential detail lost is an operational reading of readability, not demand all decorative pixels remain visible.
rules.alternative: A check whose silhouette reads clearly but subtle nonessential highlight merges with panel remains valid; a check lost against panel fails.
rules.disposition: Keep essential silhouette scope; no exact palette or all-detail contrast threshold.
rules.returned_literal_check: Composited on #172336, the silhouette is readable at 1x and at 3x nearest-neighbor scale, with no essential detail lost into the panel colour.
rules.verified_disposition: Corrected returned literal wording inspected; consistent for this proposal only.

source.quote: the existing UI's cool blue accent; a fixed palette is not required

rules.obligation: Use recognizable existing cool blue accent; source does not require blue to dominate or exact #70b9ed.
rules.literal_delta: Old 'dominant colour treatment' adds extent/dominance absent from source.
rules.alternative: Mostly neutral check/plate with a legible cool blue accent uses the requested accent while its dominant fill is neutral; old literal rule can reject it.
rules.disposition: Remove dominance; retain perceptible blue accent relation, no exact hue/count/coverage threshold.
rules.returned_literal_check: The image visibly uses the existing UI cool blue accent direction, with assets/start.svg fill #70b9ed as a colour cue. Other colours may dominate; exact hex equality and palette count are not required.
rules.verified_disposition: Corrected returned literal wording inspected; consistent for this proposal only.

source.quote: Create coherent pixel-art status assets ... propose a representative status sample before expanding the family.

rules.obligation: Pixel-art quality and plausible extensibility need expert assessment; exact cluster/edge construction is not owner-specified.
rules.literal_delta: Old clean clusters/no noisy strays/blur/downscaled artifacts is expert sample criterion. Blanket isolation/partial-alpha/process ban would exceed basis.
rules.alternative: Deliberate isolated sparkle or partial-alpha edge that preserves a readable pixel-art check can satisfy source; automatically rejecting either imposes a recipe. Art made by resampling but with no visible defect cannot be rejected for an inferred route.
rules.disposition: Retain scoped expert output quality, distinguish accidental defects from deliberate detail and prohibit route inference; no family approval implied.
rules.returned_literal_check: For this proposed representative sample, pixel clusters, contours and detail placement appear deliberate and support recognition at 1x and 3x on the panel. Judge accidental stray pixels or resampling defects by their visible effect on readability and craft. Intentional isolated details, selective authored antialiasing, partial alpha, shading and backing motifs are permitted. Do not infer or reject a production route from appearance. This expert sample criterion does not approve a family style.
rules.verified_disposition: Corrected returned literal wording inspected; consistent for this proposal only.
